title: Where to Look Is Not How to Fix: Pre-Denoising Diagnostics and Modality-Dependent Control in Diffusion Composition
title_zh: 观察位置并非修复方法：扩散生成中的去噪前诊断与模态相关控制

paragraphs.en: Understanding compositional failures in text-to-image diffusion requires identifying both where stress is detectable and how intervention changes the output. We study these questions through a controlled anchor–stress protocol that jointly evaluates text-encoder diagnostics and denoiser interventions. We introduce a text-only Compositional Stress Index (CSI), which separates common from rare compositions across SD1.5, SDXL, and the SD3 text path and provides an upstream diagnostic coordinate. A matched six-prompt localization study links intervention location to distinct outcomes: residual-minimizing embedding adapters improve representation fit, while downstream cross-attention intervention increases color hit rate (CHR) by 0.0272. Across SD1.5 and SDXL denoiser blocks, the largest positive signed diagnostic-accessibility mean occurs at the deep encoder, whereas selective boost has its largest positive mean CHR response at decoder blocks. Selective subtraction and broad ablation reveal further modality- and architecture-dependent responses, including a substantial CHR decrease when SDXL decoder cross-attention is broadly ablated. We find a diagnosis-control dissociation under our controlled attribute-object composition setting: compositional defects are diagnosable before denoising, but the representation coordinate that exposes risk is not necessarily the coordinate or modality that improves generation.

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image diffusion models [ 12 , 29 , 26 ] have achieved remarkable generation quality but remain brittle on semantically rare attribute–object compositions [ 14 , 36 ] : a model that reliably generates “a red car” may fail on “a blue pizza” or “a glass cat,” producing the wrong color, material, or texture. Two threads of work address this. Inference-time methods—Attend-and-Excite [ 4 ] , SynGen [ 28 ] , StructureDiffusion [ 8 ] , Divide-and-Bind [ 19 ] , and attention-map-controlled synthesis [ 35 ] —modify denoiser cross-attention so that attribute tokens better bind to the correct object regions, typically aggregating corrections across all layers. A second line of work studies the upstream text-conditioning pathway, asking whether compositional failures originate in representation geometry [ 17 , 3 ] or in misalignment between the embedding objective and the denoiser’s binding readout [ 37 , 22 ] . Implicit in both threads is an assumption: the pipeline location where a compositional defect is most detectable is also the location where it is most effectively correctable . We test this relationship by comparing diagnostic readouts and intervention responses at distinct pipeline sites.

paragraphs.en: To make this concrete, consider modern text-to-image diffusion pipelines [ 29 , 27 , 30 , 26 , 7 ] . A text encoder first produces conditioning embeddings, which are then consumed by a denoising backbone to guide generation. In the UNet-based Stable Diffusion family, including SD1.5 and SDXL [ 29 , 26 ] , these conditioning embeddings are injected through cross-attention layers distributed across encoder, middle, and decoder blocks [ 29 , 11 , 33 ] . This architecture provides multiple internal sites at which a compositional failure may be readable, and multiple sites at which an intervention may affect the output. We use this UNet hierarchy for our block-level localization experiments, while also testing the representation-side diagnostic on an additional non-UNet text-to-image pipeline, namely Stable Diffusion 3 [ 7 ] . Our question is therefore: at which sites can compositional failures be detected , and at which can they be fixed —and does detection at a site imply fixability there?
paragraphs.zh: 为了具体说明这一点，可以考虑现代文本到图像扩散流程 [ 29 , 27 , 30 , 26 , 7 ] 。 首先，文本编码器会生成条件嵌入，随后由去噪主干网络使用这些嵌入来引导生成过程。 在基于 UNet 的 Stable Diffusion 系列中（包括 SD1.5 和 SDXL [ 29 , 26 ] ），这些条件嵌入通过分布在编码器、中间块和解码器块中的交叉注意力层注入 [ 29 , 11 , 33 ] 。 这种架构提供了多个内部位置，可以在这些位置观察到组合失败；同时也有多个位置，干预措施可能会影响最终输出。 我们在块级定位实验中使用了这种 UNet 层级结构，同时还对另一个非 UNet 的文本到图像流程——即 Stable Diffusion 3 [ 7 ] ——进行了表示侧的诊断测试。 因此，我们的问题是：在哪些位置可以检测到组合失败？又能在哪些位置进行修复？以及在某个位置能够检测是否意味着该位置也能进行修复？

paragraphs.en: Upstream: diagnosis and repair at the text encoder (Table 1 , row 1). If a text encoder processes “a blue pizza” compositionally, the full-prompt representation should be roughly recoverable from the separate representations of “blue,” “pizza,” and the surrounding context. A large deviation from this component-based reconstruction indicates that the full prompt is not factorizing into its parts. We call this deviation a non-factorization residual and aggregate it into a Compositional Stress Index (CSI), where higher CSI indicates stronger departure from compositional factorization. Within a deliberately controlled anchor–stress setting that pairs common and rare attribute–object compositions while holding the object and context fixed, CSI separates the two groups perfectly (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, ROC-AUC = 1.0 {=}1.0 ) across SD1.5, SDXL, and the SD3 text path, and provides a diagnostic coordinate for the subsequent intervention analyses. We use the text-only CSI component for the pre-denoising interpretation (Appendix B ).

paragraphs.en: Downstream: per-block modality decomposition inside the denoiser (Table 1 , rows 2–3). This representation–output comparison motivates the downstream question: once text conditioning is read out by the denoiser, which internal sites are diagnostic, and which are causally controllable? For UNet-based SD1.5 and SDXL, we compare block groups spanning the deep encoder, middle block, and decoder, using three intervention modalities: selective boosting, selective zeroing, and broad cross-attention ablation. We quantify denoiser-side readout by diagnostic accessibility (DA), a block-level measure of how well cross-attention patterns separate anchor from stress prompts during baseline generation. The results reveal a second dissociation, now within the denoiser: D2 has the largest positive signed DA mean, while decoder blocks have the largest positive mean CHR response to selective boosting. Broad ablation produces a different, architecture-dependent profile, with a substantial CHR decrease at SDXL U0 and at early SD1.5 encoder blocks. paragraphs.en: The cross-attention-steering methods introduced in § 1 [ 4 , 28 , 8 , 19 , 35 ] share a design choice: they aggregate attention signal across all layers and resolutions, treating cross-attention as a homogeneous control surface; logit-level masking and entity-region constraints (e.g., MaskDiffusion-style methods, box-guided attention control) target specific resolutions or layers but similarly do not decompose across stages. WiCLP [ 37 ] pivots upstream, showing embedding-level repair can work with supervision aligned to the denoiser’s readout and implicating objective misalignment rather than the embedding space itself. Our findings should not be interpreted as evidence that all upstream interventions fail. WiCLP, for instance, demonstrates that embedding-space interventions can improve compositional generation when optimized with denoising-aligned objectives. Our result is narrower: reducing the CSI-diagnosed residual via residual minimization is not sufficient to guarantee semantic improvement. Marioriyad et al. [22] link entity-missing to attention overlap. A complementary line of work intervenes at training or sampling time rather than at inference attention, including contrastive curriculum fine-tuning [ 10 ] , sampling-time corrective steering [ 6 ] , and PAC-Bayesian priors over attention distributions [ 15 ] . Our contribution is orthogonal to all of these: we diagnose where in the pipeline compositional risk appears and characterize which modality works at each site, producing a layer-selection principle that could inform any of these approaches—training-time methods might focus supervision on the deep-encoder representation we identify, while sampling-time correctors gain most by operating on decoder-side attention.

paragraphs.en: On the representation and evaluation side, CLIP embeddings admit sparse linear decompositions [ 3 ] and compose single-object attributes but fail under multi-object binding [ 17 ] . Prompt-to-Prompt [ 11 ] showed cross-attention encodes spatial and semantic structure; FreeU [ 31 ] demonstrated that UNet encoder–decoder information flow is a control axis. More broadly, probing and causal intervention research [ 1 , 2 , 34 , 9 , 24 ] has shown that probe-friendly layers need not be intervention-friendly. We sharpen this gap for diffusion cross-attention by identifying both which layer and which modality works at each layer, and we quantify a pre-denoising non-factorization signal not captured by these prior analyses. Output-side benchmarks [ 14 , 32 , 18 ] measure whether composition fails; our work diagnoses where the failure originates and how to intervene at each site. Extended related work covering compositional evaluation suites, object-centric representations, and energy-based compositional generation appears in Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: We study controlled compositional stress in text-to-image diffusion. Each example consists of an anchor prompt paired with a single stress prompt that shares the same object and context but differs in the target attribute. The anchor uses a common attribute–object composition, whereas the stress prompt uses a rarer or less typical composition. Given such pairs, we ask two questions: where in the model is the stress signal diagnostically readable, and where can an intervention causally improve the generated output?

paragraphs.en: Our experiments instantiate this setup with 432 prompts organized into 216 paired groups, each consisting of one anchor prompt and one stress prompt. Attribute–object combinations are selected from T2I-CompBench [ 14 ] , CLEVR [ 16 ] , and ARO [ 36 ] lexicons to span common and rare compositional regimes (examples in Appendix N ). For example, within one group the anchor might be “a studio photo of a red pizza” and the stress prompt “a studio photo of a blue pizza”—same object, same context, different attribute. Examples such as “a red car” and “a blue pizza” that appear elsewhere in the paper illustrate the rarity gradient across the dataset, not within-pair variation.

paragraphs.en: Primary models for generation and denoiser-side intervention are SD1.5 and SDXL, while SD3 is used only for text-path diagnostic extension. paragraphs.en: To separate where an intervention is applied from what kind of intervention it is, we organize denoiser-side edits along two axes: selectivity , whether the edit targets only the attribute token or the entire cross-attention map, and sign , whether the edit strengthens or weakens the conditioning channel. This gives a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 design; the broad-additive cell is omitted because uniformly scaling all attention weights is canceled by post-softmax normalization, leaving three testable denoiser-side families. Selective additive ( boost ) amplifies attention to the target attribute token at a chosen block, testing whether stronger local attribute readout improves binding. Selective subtractive ( attr_zero ) removes the same attribute-token attention, testing the opposite direction as a matched-selectivity control. Broad subtractive ( zero ) uniformly flattens all cross-attention at a chosen block, testing whether the block’s entire text-conditioning contribution is necessary or harmful. Together with two embedding-level repair families—pooled and token low-rank adapters trained to move stress representations toward anchor-like structure—this yields five intervention families. Implementation details and statistical testing protocols are given in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 为了将干预的应用位置与其干预类型区分开来，我们沿着两个维度组织去噪器侧的编辑：选择性（selectivity），即编辑是仅针对属性标记还是整个交叉注意力图；以及符号（sign），即编辑是增强还是削弱条件化通道。 这形成了一个 2 × 2 2{\times}2 的设计；广义加法单元格被省略，因为对所有注意力权重进行统一缩放会被后 softmax 归一化抵消，因此剩下三个可测试的去噪器侧家族。 选择性加法（boost）在选定的区块中增强对目标属性标记的注意力，以测试更强的局部属性读取是否能改善绑定。 选择性减法（attr_zero）移除相同的属性标记注意力，作为匹配选择性的对照，以测试相反方向的效果。 广义减法（zero）在选定的区块中均匀地平坦化所有交叉注意力，以测试该区块的整个文本条件化贡献是否必要或有害。 结合两种嵌入层修复家族——池化器和标记低秩适配器（后者经过训练，可将压力表示向锚点类似的结构移动）——这形成了五个干预家族。 实现细节和统计检验协议见附录 D。

paragraphs.en: These three denoiser modalities span a natural hypothesis space about the defect’s structure. If the failure reflects weak attribute readout, boost should help by amplifying the target-attribute channel. If the same channel is causally involved but harmful or mislocalized, attr_zero tests the opposite direction by removing it. If the failure is distributed across the block’s entire text-conditioning pathway, zero tests whether removing that contribution improves generation. Testing all three at each block allows us to diagnose not just where the defect is, but what kind of defect it is. All intervention hyperparameters are fixed across block comparisons (strength, mask quantile, timestep schedule, and CFG settings in Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 这三种去噪模态共同构成了一个关于缺陷结构的自然假设空间。 如果故障反映了属性读取能力的不足，增强操作应通过放大目标属性通道来提供帮助。 如果同一通道在因果链中起作用但产生了有害影响或定位错误，attr_zero 会通过移除该通道来测试相反方向的效果。 如果故障分布在整个区块的文本条件通路中，zero 测试将检验移除这一贡献项是否能改善生成效果。 在每个区块中对这三种情况进行测试，使我们不仅能诊断出缺陷的位置，还能判断其类型。 所有干预超参数在各区块的比较中均保持一致（包括强度、掩码分位数、时间步长规划以及附录 D 中的 CFG 设置）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate control with object-local color hit rate (CHR): the fraction of pixels inside a fixed target-object mask whose color matches the desired attribute. The object mask is derived from baseline final-timestep attention and held fixed across conditions, which fixes the scoring region but does not independently verify object identity or localization; mask stability across interventions is verified in Appendix I . In the full per-block runs, CHR is finite for 52 stress prompts per seed; the other 164 stress prompts have no target color recorded by the scorer. This is a scoring-eligibility criterion, not a verified taxonomy of prompt semantics. We use chromatic binding because it changes attribute semantics while largely preserving object shape and localization, providing the cleanest endpoint for site-localization comparisons. Color prototypes and thresholds are reported in Appendix I . For the audited per-block results, we first average paired differences across seeds, then test across prompts (CE) or matched group_id units (DA). We use two-sided sign-flip tests (5,000 Monte Carlo draws, plus-one correction; exact enumeration for at most 16 units) and 2,000 percentile-bootstrap draws, with analysis seed 0. BH correction is applied separately to DA and CE across all active blocks within each model/run. Full CE analyses use 52 prompts with five seeds for boost/attr-zero and three for broad zeroing; DA uses 216 groups. Group IDs do not by themselves establish independence of shared anchor texts.

paragraphs.en: We first ask whether compositional stress is already visible before denoising, using only text-encoder representations. The goal is not to establish CSI as a general-purpose detector of arbitrary compositional failure, but to obtain a calibrated axis that orders prompts by stress severity before testing where intervention can change the generated output. On the controlled anchor–stress protocol, CSI cleanly separates common-composition anchors from rare-composition stress prompts across SD1.5, SDXL, and the SD3 text path (ROC-AUC = 1.0 {=}1.0 , pair-ranking = 1.0 {=}1.0 ; Figure 2 ). This ceiling-level separation should be interpreted with the protocol in mind: stress prompts are deliberately constructed to be semantically rare, and a frequency-only baseline already reaches ROC-AUC = 0.79 {=}0.79 . Thus, the important claim is not that CSI is a universal binary detector, but that text-side non-factorization provides a stable pre-denoising stress coordinate.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先仅使用文本编码器表示，探究在去噪之前是否已经能够观察到组合性压力。 我们的目标并非将CSI确立为检测任意组合性故障的通用工具，而是获得一个经过校准的维度，用于在测试干预能否改变生成结果之前，按压力严重程度对提示进行排序。 在受控的锚点–压力协议中，CSI能够清晰地区分SD1.5、SDXL以及SD3文本路径中的常见组合锚点与罕见组合压力提示（ROC-AUC = 1.0 {=}1.0，成对排序 = 1.0 {=}1.0；图2）。 这种天花板级别的区分效果应结合该协议本身来理解：压力提示被刻意设计为语义上罕见的，而仅基于频率的基线模型已经能达到ROC-AUC = 0.79 {=}0.79。 因此，重要的结论并非CSI是某种普适的二元检测器，而是文本侧的非因子分解特性提供了一种稳定的去噪前压力坐标。

paragraphs.en: The stronger evidence is that CSI remains informative within the stress set and aligns with output-side failures. Across stress prompts, CSI correlates with graded stress severity (decile-stress Spearman ρ = 0.87 \rho{=}0.87 ) and with BLIP-derived attribute failure rate (Spearman ρ = 0.68 \rho{=}0.68 ); output-side BLIP-VQA labels ( n = 4320 n{=}4320 ) show that CSI predicts attribute failure with ROC-AUC = 0.89 {=}0.89 and binding failure with ROC-AUC = 0.85 {=}0.85 . Controls support this interpretation: group-preserving permutation gives null ROC-AUC = 0.49 ± 0.01 =0.49\pm 0.01 (all empirical p = 0.001 p{=}0.001 ), text-side non-factorization is the dominant contributor, span-only geometry is substantially weaker, and robustness to lexical confounds and family ablations is reported in Appendix B . The pattern is also consistent across encoder families: SD1.5 uses a single CLIP text encoder, SDXL uses dual encoders (CLIP-L + OpenCLIP-G), and the SD3 text-path extension uses a T5-XXL sequence mean. Despite these architectural differences, the non-factorization gap appears in all three settings, so we use CSI as a model-agnostic pre-denoising stratification axis for the intervention analyses in § 5 –§ 6 .

paragraphs.en: Taken together, the upstream and downstream analyses reveal a specific property of diffusion pipelines: as the conditioning representation flows from text encoder to denoiser cross-attention, the features that are most informative about which prompts will fail and the features that are most responsive to interventions that correct failure live in different places. Text-encoder residuals provide a diagnostic coordinate; D2 has the largest positive signed DA mean; and decoder blocks have the largest positive boost CE means. Together these measurements locate distinct diagnostic and intervention-response profiles along the pipeline. The site-level mismatch extends to the prompt level as well: CSI-stratified analysis shows no consistent positive correlation between pre-denoising stress severity and decoder boost response (SDXL partial ρ = − 0.17 \rho{=}-0.17 , p = 0.007 p{=}0.007 ; SD1.5 ρ = + 0.11 \rho{=}+0.11 , ns), so diagnostic severity does not predict which prompts respond to intervention. Diagnosis and intervention are not aligned by default along the pipeline; whether they can be realigned depends on choices about objective (embedding repair, § 5 ) and modality (per-block decomposition, § 6 ), not merely site.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，上游和下游分析揭示了扩散管道的一项特定属性：当条件表示从文本编码器流向去噪器的交叉注意力时，最能说明哪些提示会失败的特征与对纠正失败的干预反应最敏感的特征位于不同位置。 文本编码器的残差提供了一个诊断坐标；D2具有最大的正号DA均值；而解码器块则具有最大的正号boost CE均值。 这些测量值共同定位了管道中不同的诊断和干预响应特征。 这种站点级别的失配也延伸到了提示层面：按CSI分层分析显示，去噪前的压力严重程度与解码器boost响应之间没有一致的正相关关系（SDXL部分ρ = −0.17 \rho{=}-0.17，p = 0.007 p{=}0.007；SD1.5 ρ = +0.11 \rho{=}+0.11，ns），因此诊断严重程度无法预测哪些提示会对干预产生响应。 在管道中，诊断和干预默认并未对齐；它们能否重新对齐取决于对目标（嵌入修复，§5）和模态（逐块分解，§6）的选择，而不仅仅是站点本身。

paragraphs.en: Two mechanistic observations sharpen the dissociation. At D2, neither tested token-level intervention shows an FDR-significant CHR effect and per-timestep analysis shows DA–CE anti-correlation—D2 is most diagnostic in early denoising precisely when boost is most destructive. We interpret this carefully: our tested attribute-token operators (additive boost, matched-selectivity zeroing, fractional attenuation) do not reach the defect, but the underlying structure is not uniquely identified, since the pattern is equally consistent with a distributed defect across D2’s cross-attention output and with a localized defect in a representation subspace our operators miss. At the decoder, U0’s negative DA ( − 0.0118 -0.0118 , FDR q = 0.00033 q{=}0.00033 in the SDXL boost baseline) indicates a reverse anchor–stress ABM contrast; the decoder does not lack signal but faithfully executes whatever binding it receives, including incorrect upstream binding. Overriding existing binding with a competing signal is one possible interpretation, not a mechanism established by these comparisons. These findings motivate evaluating diagnostic readouts and intervention operators jointly while selecting intervention sites using measured output responses.
paragraphs.zh: 两项机制层面的观察结果使这种解离更加清晰。 在 D2 处，所测试的两种词元级干预措施均未表现出具有 FDR 显著性的 CHR 效应，而逐时间步分析则显示 DA 与 CE 存在负相关——D2 在早期去噪阶段最具诊断价值，而这恰恰是增强机制破坏性最强的时候。 我们对此需谨慎解读：我们所测试的属性-词元操作符（加法增强、匹配选择性的归零、分数衰减）未能触及缺陷本身，但底层结构也未被唯一确定，因为该模式既可能与 D2 的交叉注意力输出中分布式的缺陷一致，也可能与我们的操作符未能覆盖到的表示子空间中局部化的缺陷一致。 在解码器中，U0 的负 DA（−0.0118，SDXL 增强基线中的 FDR q = 0.00033）表明存在反向的锚点-压力 ABM 对比；解码器并非缺乏信号，而是忠实地执行其所接收的任何绑定，包括来自上游的错误绑定。 用竞争性信号覆盖现有绑定是一种可能的解释，但这些比较并未证实这是一种既定机制。 这些发现促使我们在选择干预位置时，结合测量得到的输出响应，对诊断读数和干预操作符进行联合评估。

paragraphs.en: Beyond our own protocol, the modality–site dissociation has implications for existing inference-time methods. Attend-and-Excite [ 4 ] and SynGen [ 28 ] apply gradient-based corrections across all cross-attention layers simultaneously; our per-block decomposition suggests their effectiveness may concentrate at decoder blocks, because decoder blocks have the largest positive boost CE means in our sweeps. If the encoder-side contribution is zero or negative, all-layer methods may succeed despite their encoder-side component rather than because of it—a testable prediction: restricting A&E/SynGen updates to decoder-only cross-attention should preserve or improve performance while reducing compute, and restricting to encoder-only should degrade performance to baseline or worse.

paragraphs.en: More broadly, the diagnosis–control mismatch is not specific to diffusion models. Any system with a separated encoder and decoder—including encoder-decoder language models, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, and vision-language models—faces the same structural question: does diagnosing a defect in the encoder tell you how to fix it in the decoder? Our results suggest the answer is not automatic. The features that make a defect visible (high mutual information with the anchor/stress label) need not be the features that make it fixable (responsive to targeted intervention). paragraphs.en: The central conclusion of this work is not that a particular intervention site universally solves compositional failures. Rather, our evidence establishes that diagnostic accessibility, representation modification, and semantic improvement should not be assumed to coincide. paragraphs.en: We characterize compositional diagnosis and intervention through complementary measurements of text representations, cross-attention, and generated color agreement. Text-only CSI provides an upstream stress coordinate across SD1.5, SDXL, and the SD3 text path under the controlled anchor–stress protocol. Within the two tested UNets, the largest positive signed DA mean occurs at D2, while the largest positive selective-boost CE mean occurs at decoder blocks. A matched six-prompt localization study further links intervention location to output response, with downstream intervention increasing CHR as residual-minimizing adapters improve representation fit. Broad ablation reveals distinct architecture-dependent sensitivity profiles. Together, these findings provide an empirical site–modality map and motivate choosing intervention sites through output-response evaluation alongside diagnostic analysis. Extending this framework to broader compositional benchmarks, binding-aligned objectives, and DiT backbones offers concrete directions for future work. Code, CSI computation scripts, prompts, and seeds will be released on GitHub upon publication.

paragraphs.en: A growing body of work examines compositional generation and evaluation in controlled settings. Okawa et al. [25] show that compositional abilities in diffusion models emerge multiplicatively rather than additively, consistent with our finding that compositional entanglement in text representations resists simple additive decomposition. Marioriyad et al. [23] provide a systematic evaluation comparing diffusion and autoregressive architectures on compositionality, reinforcing that compositional failures are architecture-general. Broader evaluation suites—T2I-CompBench++ [ 14 ] , Winoground [ 32 ] , CREPE [ 21 ] , and SugarCrepe [ 13 ] —measure compositional success at the output level across attribute, relation, and object categories; our work is complementary, diagnosing where inside the pipeline these failures originate rather than whether they occur.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的研究在受控环境中探讨了组合生成与评估。Okawa 等人 [25] 指出，扩散模型中的组合能力是以乘法而非加法方式出现的，这与我们的发现一致：文本表示中的组合纠缠难以通过简单的加法分解来处理。Marioriyad 等人 [23] 提供了一项系统性评估，比较了扩散模型和自回归架构在组合性方面的表现，进一步证实了组合性失败是架构无关的普遍问题。 更广泛的评估套件——T2I-CompBench++ [14]、Winoground [32]、CREPE [21] 和 SugarCrepe [13]——在属性、关系和对象类别中从输出层面衡量组合能力的成功程度；我们的研究则与之互补，旨在诊断这些失败究竟源于处理流程的哪个环节，而非仅仅判断它们是否存在。

paragraphs.en: Object-centric and disentangled representation learning [ 20 ] provides a conceptual parallel: slot-based models enforce compositional structure by design, whereas text-to-image diffusion models inherit whatever compositional structure CLIP-family encoders provide. Energy-based compositional generation [ 5 ] offers an alternative compositional mechanism through explicit concept combination at sampling time. Our per-block analysis connects to these perspectives by showing that D2’s cross-attention—the site where compositional defects are most visible—does not support token-level decomposition of the defect, consistent with a representation that lacks the disentangled structure needed for targeted repair.
paragraphs.zh: 以对象为中心且解耦的表示学习 [ 20 ] 提供了一个概念上的类比：基于槽位的模型通过设计强制施加组合结构，而文本到图像扩散模型则继承自 CLIP 系列编码器所提供的任何组合结构。 基于能量的组合生成 [ 5 ] 通过在采样时显式结合概念，提供了一种替代性的组合机制。 我们的逐块分析与这些观点相关联，因为它表明 D2 的交叉注意力——组合缺陷最明显的部位——并不支持对缺陷进行词元级别的分解，这与缺乏实现针对性修复所需解耦结构的表示方式一致。

paragraphs.en: Two low-rank adapter families (rank 32, AdamW, 800 epochs, MSE objective) are evaluated. The original pooled-adapter run has 20 representation-evaluable prompts ( Δ repr = − 0.0998 \Delta_{\text{repr}}{=}-0.0998 , q = 0.0024 q{=}0.0024 ); the original token-adapter run has 19 ( − 0.1836 -0.1836 , q = 0.0008 q{=}0.0008 ). Each has seven CHR-evaluable prompts with observed zero paired change ( p = q = 1 p{=}q{=}1 ); this small-sample observation does not establish equivalence. Within each run, BH correction covers representation residual and CHR. Separate full-scale rank-sweep runs evaluate 216 representation prompts and 52 CHR prompts: pooled adapters show no significant positive CHR effect, while token adapters have negative CHR effects. paragraphs.en: The object-local color hit rate (CHR) measures target-color agreement within an attention-derived object region. In the audited full per-block runs, 52 of 216 stress prompts have finite CHR across the required seeds; the other 164 have no target color recorded by the scorer. Baseline diagnostics did not attribute these exclusions to invalid masks. Absence of a recognized target color is not a verified semantic category label. Seed-level scores are paired within prompt and then averaged, giving 52 statistical units for CE, rather than 52 × seeds 52\times\text{seeds} . Earlier expansion runs have only six CHR-evaluable stress prompts and are not used in the phase1 boost table.
paragraphs.zh: 对象局部颜色命中率（CHR）衡量的是注意力生成的对象区域内目标颜色的一致性。 在经审计的完整每块运行中，216个压力提示中有52个在所有必要种子下具有有限的CHR；其余164个则未被评分者记录任何目标颜色。 基线诊断并未将这些排除归因于无效掩码。 缺乏被识别的目标颜色并不构成一个经过验证的语义类别标签。 种子级别的分数在提示内部进行配对，然后取平均值，从而为CE提供52个统计单元，而非52 × 种子数（52\times\text{seeds}）。 早期的扩展运行仅包含六个可评估CHR的压力提示，且未用于阶段1的提升表中。

paragraphs.en: To rule out that all-timestep averaging masks a controllable window at D2, we run boost restricted to early ( ≤ 33 % \leq 33\% ), mid ( 33 33 – 66 % 66\% ), or late ( > 66 % >66\% ) denoising phases separately (Table 10 ).
